text: Repair server.py for this disposable local app. GET /health returns 200 and JSON {"status":"ok"}. GET /users?name=... must use a parameterized SQLite query, return only an exact matching name, and return [] for SQL injection strings. Preserve normal Alice lookup and never execute user input as SQL. Keep the --port interface. Inspect relevant files, save a brief plan, use native tools to implement the change, and test it. Report what you actually ran and any remaining uncertainty. Preserve existing public interfaces. Keep your explanation brief.
